The geodes have a rough tan-to-brown exterior with sparkling quartz crystal interiors ranging from white to slightly yellowish hues. Sizes vary from golf ball-sized or smaller for the halves to roughly baseball-sized for the largest uncut specimen. All pieces are in raw, unpolished condition with visible natural mineral formations and some dirt or earth residue. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or mineral displays.

Vesuvio Minerali Naturali Mineral Rock Collection Set in Wooden Display Case
Vesuvio 'Minerali Naturali' natural mineral and rock collection set housed in a wooden display case. Includes labeled volcanic minerals and stones from Mount Vesuvius such as olivine, granite, sulfur, silvestrite, calcite, pyrite, quartz, amethyst, obsidian, and more. Each specimen is in its own compartment with clear labeling. Also includes an assorted lot of polished and rough gemstones and minerals featuring quartz points, agate slices, tiger's eye, malachite, rose quartz, and various tumbled stones in different colors and shapes. Original wooden case displays vivid images of Mount Vesuvius and is suitable for educational or collectible use. Items are in good used condition.
